messages:
tara: Quick sync — EU-compliance demo with Datadog next Thurs 09:30 CET. Need a telemetry + residency checklist. @mike can you lead the infra side? :calendar: 

mike: Yep. I can own sandbox infra and collector config. Need KMS details and whether we go agentless OTLP or a proxy collector.

chloe: I will curate the dashboard and the demo flows. Can we show per-tenant traces + quota/cost panels?

sven_dd: Datadog side can host the tile in the EU region. We need traces exported to the Datadog EU endpoint and a short how-to for our tile. Will provide sample OTLP snippets.

jaime_security: For EU PII constraints we'll need PII redaction, retention policy, and KMS key rotation notes. Please include the dataflow diagram in the runbook.

oliver_si: SI team can simulate an air-gapped customer scenario. We'll need an offline collector bundle and instructions for secure transfer.

mike: Draft OTLP receiver/exporter config below — I'll validate in sandbox today:

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api: "https://trace.datadoghq.eu"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

Need ENV var for DATADOG_API_KEY stored in our secret store (no hardcodes). Also planning to strip heavy attrs before export.

tara: Action list: mike (infra + config), chloe (dashboards + demo flows), jaime_security (compliance checklist + retention), oliver_si (SI airgap bundle), sven_dd (DD tile + runbook). I'll draft the announcement and handle calendar invite. :rocket: 

chloe: Dashboard notes — include latency SLO panel, per-model token-cost estimate, fallback-route traces, and a simple 'privacy' overlay showing what we redact.

sven_dd: We'll prepare the tile assets and a short integration doc. Also can provide a time-limited test API key for the demo environment.

jaime_security: Confirming default retention: EU traces 90 days. Mark PII redaction on spans containing prompt_text, user_input, email, etc.

mike: I'll spin up the EU sandbox cluster and post the kube manifest + helm values by 18:00 CET today. ETA for collector smoke test: this afternoon.

oliver_si: For the airgap flow: I'll build offline collector tarball + install script, plus transfer checklist. Will attach artifact when ready.

tara: Quick follow-up — we should avoid sending raw prompt text to Datadog. Chloe & Mike please confirm the pipeline strips prompts and only sends token-level metrics + span metadata.

chloe: We'll redact prompt_text at the span processor stage and only emit token_count, model_name, latency_ms, and error flags.

mike: Confirmed — collector will drop attributes ['prompt_text','user_input'] and hash any user identifiers before export.

sven_dd: Noted on our side. We'll reflect this in the demo privacy blurb and in the tile docs.

tara: Perfect. I'll create the runbook stub in the partnerships drive (link forthcoming) and send the calendar invite. @sven_dd please DM the demo credentials when available.

dd-demo-bot: Demo creds created (read-only), expires in 72h: demo-eu-2026-abc123 — DM sent.

tara: Thanks everyone — rough timeline looks good. We'll reconvene tomorrow if any blockers pop up. :white_check_mark:
